basic_details.job_title: APSLSA Other Person Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 16 Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate with adequate experience in Public Utility Services
qualification.details: Qualification: Graduate with adequate experience in Public Utility Services; Citizen of India Experience: Adequate experience in Public Utility Services Age limit: Below 65 years (as on 1 November 2026) | Other conditions: | Applicant must be a citizen of India Experience must be in Public Utility Services as declared under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 | Desirable: | Candidates who have worked with Legal Services Authority with satisfactory performance may be given preference

salary_details.pay_scale: Sitting fee Rs.2500 per sitting plus conveyance allowance as prescribed

how_to_apply: Fill the prescribed application form annexed to the notification.
Affix a self-attested recent photograph on the form.
Enclose a self-addressed envelope with Speed Post postal stamps.
Enclose self-attested experience certificates, if any, and self-attested matriculation certificate.
Application must reach the Office of APSLSA, Amaravati on or before 5.00 PM on 07-12-2026.
important_instructions: Applicants may give choice districts in order of preference in the form APSLSA may cancel or modify the notification or accept or reject any candidature without assigning reasons Form requires declarations on insolvency, conviction, litigation, health, financial interest in public utility service, removal from office, LSA attachment and active politics

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate with adequate experience in Public Utility Services; Citizen of India Experience: Adequate experience in Public Utility Services Age limit: Below 65 years (as on 1 November 2026) Other conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India Experience must be in Public Utility Services as declared under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 Desirable: Candidates who have worked with Legal Services Authority with satisfactory performance may be given preference

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for APSLSA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Members shall not be eligible for re-appointment

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Members hold office for a maximum term of five years or till attaining 65 years, whichever is earlier Not eligible for re-appointment

content_sections.heading: How Will APSLSA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Interview by the Hon'ble Executive Chairman or person / persons authorised by the Hon'ble Executive Chairman Interview taken by the Hon'ble Executive Chairman or persons authorised by him Enclosed papers verified at the time of interview Decision of the Hon'ble Executive Chairman, APSLSA is final on selection and posting

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-addressed envelope with Speed Post postal stamps Self-attested certificates of experience, if any Self-attested matriculation certificate Self-attested recent photograph on the form

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for APSLSA Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Fill the prescribed application form annexed to the notification. Affix a self-attested recent photograph on the form. Enclose a self-addressed envelope with Speed Post postal stamps. Enclose self-attested experience certificates, if any, and self-attested matriculation certificate. Application must reach the Office of APSLSA, Amaravati on or before 5.00 PM on 07-12-2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applicants may give choice districts in order of preference in the form APSLSA may cancel or modify the notification or accept or reject any candidature without assigning reasons Form requires declarations on insolvency, conviction, litigation, health, financial interest in public utility service, removal from office, LSA attachment and active politics

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for APSLSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in APSLSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 16 vacancies for Other Person (Member).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for APSLSA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed application form annexed to the notification (pages 3-4)) and send it to Office of Andhra Pradesh State Legal Services Authority, Amaravati, by post or delivery to the office; the authority is not responsible for post office delays, to reach by 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 65 years (as on 1 November 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Sitting fee Rs.2500 per sitting plus conveyance allowance as prescribed.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate with adequate experience in Public Utility Services.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicant must be a citizen of India. Experience must be in Public Utility Services as declared under the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Members shall not be eligible for re-appointment.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview by the Hon'ble Executive Chairman or person / persons authorised by the Hon'ble Executive Chairman. Interview taken by the Hon'ble Executive Chairman or persons authorised by him. Enclosed papers verified at the time of interview. Decision of the Hon'ble Executive Chairman, APSLSA is final on selection and posting.

faq.answer: Members hold office for a maximum term of five years or till attaining 65 years, whichever is earlier. Not eligible for re-appointment.
